title: Unit 14 Test
subtitle: going to · future plans · infinitive of purpose · weather · transport

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences. Use going to.

items.q: We (buy) ______ a new car next year.

sections.title: B. Write questions with going to.

a: What are you going to do tomorrow
Where are they going to stay
Is she going to learn to drive
When is he going to come back
When’s he going to come back

sections.title: C. Look at the pictures in your mind. What is going to happen? Choose the correct answer.

items.q: There are black clouds in the sky.
The man is running for the bus, but it’s leaving.
The glass is at the edge of the table and the cat is near it.

sections.title: D. Why? Match and complete. Use to + verb.

items.q: We’re going to Samarkand ______ the old buildings.
He went to the shop ______ some bread.

sections.title: F. Read the email. Are the sentences true or false?
sections.passage: Hi Laura! Great news — I’m going to visit you in London next month! I’m going to fly from Tashkent on 3rd June and stay for ten days. First I’m going to do an English course for a week. Then I’m going to travel to Oxford by train to see the university. I’m not going to stay in a hotel — I’m going to stay with a family. I can’t wait! Love, Dildora

items.q: Dildora is going to visit Laura next week.
She’s going to stay for ten days.
She’s going to do an English course.
She’s going to go to Oxford by bus.
She’s going to stay in a hotel.
